scenarios.unchanged: identical reports must produce no findings at all
scenarios.new_period: a newly published annual period is INFO: legitimate new filings are not a regression
scenarios.restatement: a value change carried by a later accession for the same period is a permitted restatement, not an unexplained change
scenarios.field_lost: a previously available field missing from the candidate reduces coverage (WARNING)
scenarios.observation_lost: a usable observation becoming MISSING_OBSERVATION is a WARNING
scenarios.debt_concept_demoted: moving to a lower-priority contract concept for the debt split is a WARNING
scenarios.prohibited_substitution: substituting consolidated net income for common income is a prohibited accounting substitution (FAIL)
scenarios.invalid_unit_conversion: a thousand-fold move with an unchanged unit is an unconverted scale (FAIL)
scenarios.contract_unit_violation: a unit outside the contract unit for the field is a FAIL
scenarios.source_version_mismatch: a value change under the same accession with a changed source object revision is an unresolved change (WARNING)
scenarios.unexplained_value_change: a material value change with no new filing and no source revision is a FAIL
scenarios.manifest_integrity_failure: a release that stops resolving and a manifest sample that disappears are FAILs
scenarios.validation_downgrade: a validated field becoming unvalidated is a WARNING
scenarios.non_independent_validation: validation asserted while every corroborating source is the same stored object is a FAIL
scenarios.forward_availability: an observation claimed usable after the report's own as-of instant is a FAIL
scenarios.issuer_identity_change: one ticker resolving to a different issuer CIK is contradictory identity (FAIL)
scenarios.ticker_collision: two issuer identities resolving to one ticker is a FAIL
scenarios.blocked_company: a company that loses its source facts and gains a blocker is a FAIL
scenarios.as_of_regression: a candidate whose as-of instant moved earlier can only shrink coverage (WARNING)
scenarios.sanitized_pair: two sanitized summaries compare on the public fields and record the skipped checks
scenarios.leakage_attempt: private paths, hashes, credentials and restricted store names must never reach the sanitized output
scenarios.incomparable_pair: a fixture report and a live report are not comparable without an explicit override
scenarios.contract_mismatch: two different contract schemas are not comparable without an explicit override
